content:
**1) LAYOUT & REGIONS**
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 - 1024, 45):** Contains app icon/title (left), and action buttons (right).
*   **Toolbar / Navigation Bar (0, 45 - 1024, 110):** Contains navigation buttons, address bar, view controls, filter button, and search box.
*   **Main Content Area (0, 110 - 1024, 855):** Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Tree Pane (Left):** (0, 145 - 275, 855). Contains "Path/Type" tabs and the directory tree.
    *   **List Pane (Center):** (275, 145 - 800, 855). Contains column headers and the file list.
    *   **Preview/Details Pane (Right):** (800, 145 - 1024, 855). Shows details for the selected item.
*   **Status Bar / CTA Area (0, 855 - 1024, 950):** Contains scan status summary and primary action button.
*   **Windows Taskbar (0, 950 - 1024, 768).**

**2) TEXT (VERBATIM)**
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Toolbar Buttons:** `Buy Now`, `Filter`, `Search files or folders`
*   **Address Bar:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Tabs:** `Path`, `Type`
*   **List Headers:** `Name`, `Date Modified`, `Type` (Note: Checkbox column is unlabeled).
*   **Tree Items:**
    *   `Windows (C:)` | `1.1M`
    *   `File Path Lost` | `4.3K`
    *   `Reconstructed` | `88`
*   **List Items (Row Data):**
    *   `actionarchivecache` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `actions-runner` | `10/17/2026 4:38 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `azureCli` | `10/8/2026 1:50 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `cobertura-2.1.1` | `2/26/2015 11:23 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `ghcup` | `10/8/2026 12:32 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `hostedtoolcache` | `10/7/2026 11:25 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `image` | `10/7/2026 9:08 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `inetpub` | `10/7/2026 10:10 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `Julia` | `10/7/2026 11:21 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `mingw32` | `2/19/2026 12:59 PM` | `File folder`
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   `actionarchivecache`
    *   `Open` (Button)
    *   `Size`: `284 MB`
    *   `Date Modified`: `10/7/2026 11:30 PM`
    *   `Path`: `C:\`
*   **Bottom Status Bar:**
    *   `Scan Completed, Files Found:` **`1139250`** `(149.73 GB)`
    *   `Recover All ...` (Button)
*   **System Tray/Taskbar:** `4:56 PM`, `10/17/2026`, `Search`

**3) COLOR (ESTIMATED HEX)**
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window Background: `#F5F8FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   List Item Selected: `#D6E9FA` (Light Blue)
    *   List Item Hover (Inferred): Slightly darker blue or grey.
    *   Preview Pane Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Tree/List Header Background: `#F0F4F7`
*   **Surfaces & Controls:**
    *   Primary Button (Recover All): `#2B85FF` (Bright Blue)
    *   Secondary Button (Open): `#BDD6FF` (Light Blue with blue text)
    *   Buy Now Button: `#FFB84D` (Orange/Yellow)
    *   Input Fields/Borders: `#E0E0E0` or `#D1D5DB`
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Names): `#333333` or `#1F2937`
    *   Secondary Text (Dates/Sizes/Path): `#6B7280` (Grey)
    *   Text on Primary Button: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Text on Selected Row: `#000000` (Black/Dark Grey)
*   **Accents:**
    *   Success Checkmark Circle: `#2B85FF` (Blue outline), White fill.
    *   Folder Icons: `#FCD34D` (Yellow) for standard, `#60A5FA` (Blue) for selected.

**4) TYPOGRAPHY (ESTIMATES)**
*   **Title Bar:** Segoe UI / System Font, ~9pt, Regular.
*   **Headings/Tabs:** Segoe UI, ~12pt, Medium/Semi-bold (for selected tab/text).
*   **List Items (Name):** Segoe UI, ~11-12pt, Regular.
*   **Metadata (Date/Type/Size):** Segoe UI, ~9-10pt, Regular, Grey color.
*   **Status Bar Text:** Segoe UI, ~11-12pt, Bold (for numbers), Regular (for labels).

**5) SPACING & SIZING**
*   **Row Height (List):** ~40px - 44px.
*   **Icon Size (Folder):** 24x24px or 32x32px grid.
*   **Checkbox Size:** 16x16px with ~4px padding/margin from text/icon.
*   **Padding (List Item):** Left/Right ~12px, Vertical centering.
*   **Gutter (Pane Dividers):** ~1px or ~4px (if resizable handle).
*   **Button Heights:** Toolbar buttons ~32px, Main CTA ("Recover All") ~44px.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Buttons: ~4px - 6px.
    *   Search Box / Inputs: ~4px.
    *   Tabs (top left): ~4px top-left/top-right.

**6) CONTROLS & STATES**
*   **Navigation:** Back (Disabled/Greyed), Forward (Disabled), Up (Disabled).
*   **View Toggle:** List View (Selected/Active state indicated by icon style).
*   **Selection:**
    *   **Tree:** "Windows (C:)" is Expanded (arrow pointing down/right) and Selected (blue background).
    *   **List:** "actionarchivecache" is Selected (blue background). Checkboxes are unchecked (empty squares).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   "Buy Now": Normal/Accent.
    *   "Filter": Normal.
    *   "Open" (in preview): Normal/Secondary.
    *   "Recover All ...": Normal/Primary (Enabled).
*   **Sort Indicator:** Up arrow visible on "Name" column header (Ascending sort).

**7) ICONOGRAPHY**
*   **Style:** Flat, Filled (Folders), Outline (Toolbar icons like Filter, Menu, Search).
*   **Folder Icon:** Standard manila folder shape. Yellow when unselected, Blue when selected.
*   **Toolbar Icons:** Line weight ~1.5px - 2px.
*   **Status Icon:** Large checkmark inside a circle (Success state).

**8) STATE**
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Populated**. The scan has finished (`Scan Completed`), data is populated in the list, and the user is browsing results.
*   **Context:** The user is viewing the root of the C: drive (`Windows (C:)`) in "Path" view. A specific folder (`actionarchivecache`) is currently selected, triggering the Preview Pane on the right to display its metadata. The "Recover All" action is available.
